Normalized Heritage. This item preserves the original UUID for Stormborn Nomad while converting it from a species-root into an Oldenborn heritage.

“Yesod fell. The world remembered old names. You answered.”

Oldenborn (Stormborn Nomad). Your place-soul is a weather front. You are the caravan memory of every tribe that crossed the ash squalls and came out the other side. When you walk, the wind remembers that you used to be the reason it had a name.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Fey, Stormborn).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Ability Scores. Oldenborn does not grant fixed ability score bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward CON or WIS in fiction and mechanics via Tier powers.

Oldenborn Core

At character creation, you gain Old Memory, Old Flesh (Dream-Flesh, Old Paths, Veil-Sight, You Are Remembered).

Stormborn Nomad Traits

  • Weatherwise. You gain proficiency with the Survival skill. You ignore nonmagical difficult terrain caused by weather (mud, shallow snow, high winds).
  • Ward of the Gale. Once per long rest, when you would take environmental damage (from a storm, heat, or similar hazard), you can use your reaction to reduce that damage to half until the start of your next turn.
  • Nomad Networks. You learn one additional language of your choice and have advantage on ability checks to locate water, shelter, or safe passage in Desert / Ash Wastes or Swamp / Mire hexes.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / BBTTCC)

“You are the difference between ‘we crossed the wastes’ and ‘someone found the bones later.’”

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Non-Lethal OP and +1 Faith OP at campaign start.
  • Hex Synergy. In Desert / Ash Wastes or Swamp / Mire hexes, your traveling party ignores the first hazard triggered per Strategic Turn.
  • Purifying Rites. Once per Strategic Turn, you may perform a 10-minute rite. If the group succeeds on a DC 15 group check (as set by the GM), you reduce regional Darkness by 1; this costs 1 Faith OP.

Note: This heritage uses placeholder ItemGrant UUIDs. Run the Oldenborn wiring macro after you store feats/species in compendiums.
